beats: [d:intrigue][sfx:boom][act:wonder, setting the scene][tune:fall]A ^line across the sea, forty-eight kilometres long, from India to Sri ^Lanka: a chain of sandbanks you can see from ^space.

[d:tension][act:respectful, intrigued][tune:fall]^Exactly where the Ramayana, one of India's great sacred epics, says an army built a ^bridge. [act:respectful, sincere][tune:fall]For millions, it is a sacred place. [act:weighing the options][tune:rise]^Built... [act:gentle, curious][tune:fall]or ^grown?

[d:calm][act:describing it, calm][tune:fall]Up close@adj, it's sandbanks and ^shoals, mostly one to ^three metres under water: shallow enough to see the bottom from a boat. [go:2|0][act:a modern marvel, bright][tune:fall]In {2024|twenty twenty-four}, a NASA laser satellite mapped it from ^orbit. [p:0.93][act:explaining, a simple picture]It fires pulses of light and times their return, like an echo made of light; its green beam passes through shallow water and bounces off the ^floor. [act:the result, bright][tune:fall]The ridge carries straight on, underwater, from ^both land tips.

[d:build][sfx:shimmer][act:ticking them off, plain][tune:fall]It's made of ^sand, ^beachrock and ^coral. [act:explaining, clear and friendly][tune:fall]Here ^two seas meet, from the north and from the south. [p:0.93][act:explaining, a simple picture]Their waves push sand from both sides and pile it into a long ^ridge, like snow drifting against a ^fence. [act:explaining, clear and friendly][tune:fall]Ridges like this form all over the ^world.
[d:build][act:respectful, a telling detail][tune:fall]Temple records@noun say you could once walk it, until storms broke the last link, in {1480|fourteen eighty}.

[d:build][act:wonder, spacious][tune:fall]Now go back to the Ice Age: the ^whole strait was dry land, dotted with ^lakes. [act:plain, confident][tune:fall]The sea only came in about eight and a half ^thousand years ago, as the great ice sheets ^melted. [d:aside][act:playful, delighted by the paradox][tune:risefall]Which makes the bridge older than the ^sea around it.

[d:reveal][sfx:hit][act:leaning in, the missing test][tune:fall]But here's what ^nobody has done: ^drill it. [p:0.93][act:explaining, a simple picture]A drill core is a long tube of sand and rock, a slice through time, layer by ^layer. [act:careful, precise][tune:fall]A ^human layer on top of a natural ridge, stones placed by people, has never been ^tested. [act:fair, even][tune:fall]So it has never been ruled ^out.

[d:verdict][p:0.95][act:weighing it, respectful and calm][tune:rise]A bridge built by an ^army? [act:the verdict, level-headed][tune:fall]*Awaiting ^evidence*. [act:plain, simple][tune:rise]A ^natural ridge? [act:calm, confident][tune:fall]That's what ^every survey@noun so far shows.
[d:tension][p:0.93][act:with respect, sincere][tune:fall]What the epic means to the faithful is not ours to ^rate. [act:the last word, gentle and clear][tune:fall]The ^ridge is.
